preview: Sarah: Before you go, one thing: what's the part you're still weighing — the 21¢ power, or the wait for the batch?

messages.text:
At 16¢, the 40T in Eco (450 W) runs about $53 a month in power; at 40 TH/s (650 W) about $76. It's $799 for 40 TH/s — the best value per terahash we sell, and every ten minutes it's a live draw at a full 3.125 BTC block, forever.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

Good — then you already know the drill. The 40T is the biggest jump per dollar we have: 40 TH/s stock, 50 in Turbo, ~50 dB in Eco so it can sit in a room with you.

What are you running now?
I pay almost .21 a kw in MI

At 21¢ in Michigan: Eco (30 TH/s, 450 W) runs about $69 a month, 40 TH/s about $100, Turbo about $130. Most guys at your rate run Eco and still hold 30 TH/s of block draws around the clock.

Honestly, at home rates the sats usually come in under the power bill — you're buying the block shot and the hashrate. Want me to set one up?
Do you guys offer pool mining

Yes. The 40T runs Harlo OS — you drop in a stratum URL, worker and password in settings and it points at any pool you like, paying out to your own wallet. The listing says solo because that's just how it ships.

Pool it and the sats come in small and steady instead of all-or-nothing. Want it in the cart?
I have to think about it.
Before you go, one thing: what's the part you're still weighing — the 21¢ power, or the wait for the batch?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Magic Miner 40T numbers for where you live.
